nodes.label: FailedAction / RetryAction Model
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase5 - Prompt 5M: Add failed action queue model.md
nodes.rationale: Queue model for retryable local app actions: action ID, type, related entity type/ID, safe error message, created date, last attempted date, attempt count, status. Security rule: never store tokens, secrets, or raw API headers inside retry actions.

nodes.label: Retry Action Repository Interface

nodes.label: Local Retry Action Storage
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase5 - Prompt 5M: Add failed action queue model.md
nodes.rationale: Duplicate retry actions for the same release and action type are avoided where possible; failure to record a retry action must never crash the main flow.

nodes.label: Token Safety Principle
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase5 - Prompt 5M: Add failed action queue model.md
nodes.rationale: Repeated invariant across every Phase 5 and 6 slice: never hardcode secrets, never log tokens, never store tokens/secrets/raw API headers in persisted models (retry actions, DTOs, job records), never show tokens in errors or UI; always use safe error messages.
